privacyAct.legalBasis: National Digital voluntarily applies APP-level controls to this application irrespective of any small-business or other exemption under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). Confirmed by the two-person compliance review on 2026-07-19 (EV-LEGAL-DEEP-2026-07); optional research collection proceeds under opt-in-off-by-default, field minimisation, per-category consent for sensitive attributes, and aggregate-only at-rest storage.
